subject: Connecting dodged points with lines based on a grouping

messages.author: 18636d58f7894a34
messages.subject: Connecting dodged points with lines based on a grouping
parts:
In the following self-contained example, I am trying to connect the "left" and "right" measurements for each patient across the dodge by "measurement". I am close but can't quite get it to work. Any clues?

Thanks!

library("tidyverse")

data <- tibble(patient = seq(1,12,1),
               treatment = rep(c("A","B","C"), each=4),
               left = c(1.2,1.5,2.3,1.1,0.2,0.4,0.6,1.0,0.1,0.5,1.9,1.0),
               right = c(1.1,1.4,1.8,0.9,1.2,1.3,1.5,0.9,1.0,2.0,1.7,2.9)) %>%
    gather(side, measurement, -patient, -treatment)

plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x=treatment, y=measurement)) +
    geom_point(aes(color=side), position=position_dodge(width=0.75)) +
    geom_line(aes(group=patient), position=position_dodge(width=0.75))

print(plot)
ggsave("plot.jpg", plot)

Try this fallow code

library(ggpubr)

a = ggpaired(data, 
 x = "side", 
y = "measurement",
ylab = "measurement",
xlab = "Trataments",
color = "treatment",
legend = "",     # without legend
line.color = "gray", 
line.size = 0.4,
facet.by = "treatment",
palette = "jco")+
stat_compare_means(paired = TRUE, # to be paired
label.y = 3.5,
method = "t.test")
